summary.text: Jeff Warren is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 137 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is a Northampton County commissioner with about three decades in local government and works for the child-advocacy nonprofit CASA SHaW.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Jeff Warren said he has worked at every level of government over the last three decades, including service on Easton City Council and the Hanover Township Board of Supervisors and as a staff member for State Senator Lisa Boscola.
He said he currently serves as a Northampton County commissioner and works for CASA SHaW, a nonprofit that advocates for children in foster care.
He said he lives in Bethlehem Township with his wife and twin daughters.

Warren's survey responses list lowering costs for working families, protecting access to affordable healthcare, supporting good-paying jobs and making large corporations pay their fair share as campaign priorities.

He also named responsible growth, including concerns about warehouses and data centers and preserving open space and farmland, and fair school funding with greater accountability for cyber charter schools.
